title: Towards Socially Intelligent Agents with Mental State Transition and Human Value
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates human value modeling into AI agents using the Schwartz theory of basic human values. It utilizes the VALUENET dataset, which consists of social scenarios annotated with human preferences concerning ethics and morals, such as benevolence, tradition, and utilitarianism. Additionally, its case studies involve religious elements (e.g., a priest persona, cross, and bible) as part of evaluating the agent's adherence to traditional values.
